value.rationale: Post-reset recovery delays depending on displacement are a motivated extension of incomplete-reset growth/collapse models. The theorem gives a full parameter-domain classification of physical-time stationarity and rare-event phase inference, with two analytically distinct sharp thresholds and a nontrivial critical posterior prefactor. The exact collapse coefficient quantifies how activity dies as the stationary regime disappears. These quantities are physically interpretable, not an arbitrary finite parameter computation.
